title: How wide is the "millions"? Outdoor-PM2.5 death estimates

provenance.definition: Published annual death estimates attributable to outdoor air pollution. Estimates diverge because they use different exposure-response functions and pollutant scopes — not because the air differs. Lelieveld et al. 2015 (PNAS); WHO Global Health Estimates 2021; GBD 2021 (IHME); Vohra et al. 2021 (Environmental Research, fossil-fuel combustion PM2.5).
provenance.primarySource: Compiled from four peer-reviewed estimates — GBD figures are IHME-licensed (link-only).
provenance.notes: Transcribed headline figures; GBD/IHME-derived → link-only, charted but not re-hosted.

recipe.detail: Four published outdoor-air-pollution death estimates, 2015–2021, shown as a spread to make the modelling uncertainty legible.
